wordings: One MRI study reported a mean whole-pancreas volume of 82.6 cm³ in 14 people with normal glucose tolerance in the comparison group.
In one MRI study, the average volume of the whole pancreas was 82.6 cm³ among 14 people in a comparison group with normal glucose tolerance.
The reported ±4.8 cm³ is the standard error of the mean (SEM): uncertainty in the estimated group mean, rather than a range of individual sizes.
The study reported a standard error of the mean (SEM) of ±4.8 cm³. This describes uncertainty in the group's average, not the spread of individual pancreas sizes.
The study groups were matched for age, weight and sex.
The comparison groups were matched for age, weight and sex.
Treat this as a result from a selected study group, not a universal average or a CT reference range. It cannot determine whether an individual scan is normal or abnormal.
